name: Misa
message: 「If we keep up this training right up until Re-Crea...」

name: Ria
message: 「We should be in great shape by then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, when the real thing comes around, I'd love to leave it all to you guys, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother. Let's all keep doing our best every day from now on, okay!」

message: 「Bu-ut, you can't forget about preparing for the Holy Night Festival either, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright everyone, for the Holy Night Festival--」
